items.quote: We are migrating from the present hybrid category wherein we had committed a CAPEX of INR 250 crores under IT PLI 2 to the global category wherein we are upping our CAPEX plans to INR 500 crores.
As far as display is concerned, we will be putting up a CAPEX of almost closer to INR 1,000 odd crores.
Atul Lall: So the commercials for Vivo JV are still being finalized, but we estimate that the expected CAPEX is going to be somewhere around INR 300 crores to INR 350-odd crores.
